teacher.authorship: Scenario choices and explanations authored in this teacher agent session; numerical targets supplied by exact engine enumeration, not LLM estimates.

grouping: All observed positions, perturbations and rotations derived from one real game use site-game-<id>. These groups must also remain together with ext_site and any other replay corpus.

counterfactual_reachability: NOT_PROVEN_FROM_STANDARD_OPENING; legal-state constructions derived from observed positions, not actual replays
policy: Uniform mass on all exact winning first actions; otherwise uniform mass on all bounded-safe first actions when classification is complete. All legal actions retained with zero weight for excluded actions. No preference when all moves lose. No LLM numerical value guesses.
full_value: Only exact current-turn win +1 or universally forced loss before next own turn -1; all other values NaN with value_valid=false. Bounded safety does not imply eventual win.
